title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Games in bad weather
hook: The game is on, but it is cold and pouring rain.
intro: Kids are shivering on the sideline.
statement: Comfort and safety come before the score.
q1: Do you shorten shifts so no one sits in the cold long —
q3: What do you bring for kids who are underdressed?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids remember
t2: when their coach made sure they were okay.
cta: Coaches — what is your bad weather plan?
ctaLines: Short shifts. Extra layers. Blankets on the bench.
ctaPrompt: Share your weather habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
The game is on, but it is cold and pouring rain.
Kids are shivering on the sideline. The league says play.
Comfort and safety come before the score.
Adjust the rotation or play it normally. Every team is different.
What is your bad weather plan? Share your habit in the comments.
